title: MSAA_4X_HINT causes SIGTRAP in the Metal-GL render pass on macOS — crashes at first EndDrawing
evidence:
app/main.odin:58-59:
	rl.SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE, .MSAA_4X_HINT})
	rl.InitWindow(1280, 720, "Packet Plumber - Odin prototype")
Fix commit 2d99afd (4 commits after the reviewed sha on odin-prototype): "fix: drop MSAA on macOS (SIGTRAP in the Metal-GL render pass); add --soak self-play mode" / "The crash stack ran through IOGPU/Metal command-buffer allocation inside EndDrawing — the deprecated macOS OpenGL paths MSAA framebuffer. Removed MSAA_4X_HINT; flat-color vector art barely notices."
detail: The A/B's desktop target is macOS; the reviewed build traps inside EndDrawing on every frame. The minion fixed it post-review by removing the flag, so the bug is real and verified.
recommended_fix: Remove .MSAA_4X_HINT from SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE}) — exactly what fix commit 2d99afd does.

title: Dangling hint string — right-clicking a pipe (QoS toast) SIGTRAPs next frame
evidence:
app/main.odin:336:
		set_hint(app, fmt.tprintf("%s gets the Express lane on this pipe", name), frame_ms)
app/main.odin:368-369:
set_hint :: proc(app: ^App, msg: string, frame_ms: i64, ttl_ms: i64 = 2600) {
	app.hint = msg
app/main.odin:71:
		free_all(context.temp_allocator) // frame arena discipline (ODN-18)
Fix commit 650683d: "set_hint stored caller strings directly; the QoS/crisis toasts are fmt.tprintf'd (temp allocator) and the frame arena resets every frame -> the HUD read a dangling string next frame -> SIGTRAP on play (hit on any right-click)."
detail: fmt.tprintf allocates from the temp arena; the next frame's free_all frees the string while app.hint still points at it, so the HUD dereferences freed memory. The core QoS interaction crashes the game.
recommended_fix: Copy hint strings into an app-owned buffer (e.g. App.hint_buf [256]u8) in set_hint, as fix commit 650683d does.

title: Restart (R key) aborts with SIGABRT — snapshot arrays arena-allocated, heap-deleted (mixed allocators)
detail: core.run_init/step mutate the caller's context.allocator to the run arena and never restore; resnapshot then allocates snapshot arrays from the arena while run_context_destroy deletes them via the heap. Every R-restart aborts.
recommended_fix: Capture the caller's heap allocator at run_context_create, allocate/delete snapshots against it, and save/restore context.allocator around step — as fix commit 6b84abc does.

title: Junction-triage buttons label the classes swapped: 'stream' sets triage 0 = email, 'email' sets triage 1 = streaming
evidence:
app/main.odin:267,271:
		labels := [3]string{"none", "stream", "email"}
				triage := i32(i - 1)
app/render/hud.odin:266:
		active := (i == 0 && n.triage < 0) || (i > 0 && n.triage == i32(i - 1))
data/packet_types.json entries order: entries[0].id = "email", entries[1].id = "streaming"
core/qos.odin:56-57:
	if junction_triage >= 0 {
		return .Express if i32(class) == junction_triage else .Best
detail: Class 0 is email and class 1 is streaming, so the button labeled 'stream' promotes email (triage 0) and the highlight lights 'stream' when email is triaged. The player cannot actually prioritize streaming through the router.
recommended_fix: Swap the labels to {"none", "email", "stream"} in popover_click and draw_frame's draw_router_popover call, or resolve triage by class_index name instead of i-1.

title: Committed app.bin — 2MB macOS arm64 build artifact tracked in the repo root
evidence:
git ls-files -s app.bin → 100755 4aaf130a4825b3b67a49e713b76ee83b9e244843 0 app.bin
file app.bin → app.bin: Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64
.gitignore lists 'bin/' and 'goldens/_reports/' but not app.bin
Post-review fix commits re-commit it: 'app.bin | Bin 2057480 -> 2058056 bytes' (650683d) — so the artifact is actively re-committed on every build.
detail: A platform-specific binary bloats the repo (2MB per commit), cannot run on Linux/Windows checkouts, and drifts from source — the committed app.bin already lacks the crash fixes.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin and add 'app.bin' to .gitignore; builds already output to bin/, which is ignored.

title: App struct orphan fields: mode, press_valid, autopilot_wired, cosmetic_rng — written, never read
evidence:
app/main.odin:29 press_valid: bool,; :34 autopilot_wired: map[u32]bool,; :39 cosmetic_rng: pp.Rng, // ODN-15 - cosmetics only, never the sim's; :44 mode: prun.App_Mode,
Repo-wide grep: app.mode only at main.odin:44 (.Boot) and :116 (.Run) — no reads; press_valid only written at :197/:203; app.autopilot_wired only written at :114/:160 (the live autopilot map is rc.autopilot_wired, wired in app/run/autopilot.odin:15); pp.rng_seed(&app.cosmetic_rng, ...) at :64 with no consumer anywhere in app/, core/, harness/.
detail: Four App fields carry state nothing reads: the FSM field, the drag-validity flag, a second autopilot wiring map (autopilot_boot already wires rc.autopilot_wired), and an ODN-15 cosmetic RNG no cosmetic system consumes.
recommended_fix: Delete the fields plus the redundant wiring loop at main.odin:158-161, or actually route cosmetic effects through cosmetic_rng as the ODN-15 comment claims.
